description: Enable or disable Training (LMS) for one job. Enabling invites nobody and disabling deletes nothing — it only configures the job Training surface; assignment/unassignment stays exclusively on Project To-dos. Requires confirmTraining=true (explicit acknowledgement of a live shared-state change) and an idempotency key. Requires lms:write.

idempotencyKey.description: Durable-receipt idempotency key: 8-128 characters of letters, digits, dot, underscore, dash, or colon. Same key + same payload replays the stored receipt; same key + changed payload is a 409.

name: opentrain_lms_set_job_training
